This season, I will keep this small rented tuber plot simple because money is tight and I cannot risk spending too much on inputs. I will rely mostly on the rains, use local planting material, and put in family labor for planting and weeding, though I may hire a little help when the work is heavy. I do not plan to use chemical fertilizer or irrigation, but if I can get some manure or compost nearby, I will use a small amount on the plot.
